integrity: Exact analytical proof with independently reproduced finite-matrix and Gaussian-tail numerical checks. Scientific review is same-model only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Equal-prior binary vacuum-versus-coherent discrimination with n coherent training copies and a common uniform phase; not displaced noncircular priors, nonuniform phase, noisy optics, or passive-only realizability. Exact optimal POVM is a mathematical specification. General intensity prior series may have nongeometric tails.
title: Exact finite-sample coherent-state learning under phase-invariant amplitude priors
